correctness.rationale: For the ordinary Morse complex of acyclic primitive vertex-edge pairs in K2,4, independent enumeration of all 3^8 edge states gives 944 nonempty simplices, f=(16,96,272,368,192). The source gives 464 genuine face-toggle pairs and acyclic reversed Hasse digraph with one critical vertex plus 15 critical four-simplices, justifying sole reduced H4 of rank15 via Forman. Independent direct signed fixed-simplex calculation over all 48 S2×S4 automorphisms reproduces identity-part trace row (15,−3,0,−1,1) and swap-part (3,1,0,−5,1). Taking sum/difference yields 9d positive, 6d negative S2 constituents; the exact S4 character table gives S^(3,1)+2S^(2,1,1) and S^(1,1,1,1)+S^(2,1,1)+S^(2,2). Correct for this finite graph, not a general n theorem.
